comparison.objective: Harvests moving or swaying fruit; candidate removes insert tangs from a stationary shell fixture.
comparison.physical_skill: Tracking, grasping, and detaching a moving compliant target differ from coaxial rigid-tool control, hammer impact, coil protection, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Fruit harvest is title-supported; detachment/damage thresholds are unspecified. Candidate requires four modeled-notch fractures and four physically deposited tangs without damage.
comparison.reason: Detaching a dynamic fruit target is not equivalent to controlled metal-notch fracture and containment.
